name: Hydropower levelized cost of energy
descriptionShort: This data is expressed in US dollars per kilowatt-hour. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.
descriptionProcessing:
- The resulting costs are compiled from three IRENA reports: Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025 (primarily for data from 2010 onwards), Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2024 (for country series not included in the latest report), and Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2023 (for data prior to 2010, not included in later reports). Wherever reports overlap, the most recent one is used.
- Data from older reports (expressed in constant US dollars of an earlier year) was converted to constant 2025 US dollars using the [US GDP deflator (linked series)](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GDP.DEFL.ZS.AD?locations=US), to account for the effects of US dollar inflation. This matches the producer's own convention when moving between dollar base years.
descriptionKey: Levelized cost of energy (LCOE) estimates the average cost per unit of energy generated across the lifetime of a new power plant. It is measured in US$ per kilowatt-hour.
